title: Very Nice Selection
text: Got my second box this month.  Can so far say that I have been very surprised and mostly happy with the selection.  While I may not have been a fan of one flavor I have received so far, that is just personal preference.  The quality has been outstanding thus far.  I really like the variety that I have received.  If there was a downside, I would say that is if you wanted to get a larger supply of a particular tea it may not be available.  But as an addition to your regular loose leaf, this is a nice foray into the unexpected and interesting.
label: positive
